title: 'I would have gone higher': 'Selling Sunset' star pays $575K for SB jersey and ring

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: 'I would have gone higher': 'Selling Sunset' star pays $575K for SB jersey and ring
sources.description: Jason Oppenheim paid $470,000 for the game-worn jersey of Washington Hall of Famer John Riggins in Super Bowl XVII.
